messages.subject: Latent change score in R
parts:
Hi there,

I'm running the latent change score model by using R. The context is I would like to understand whether the change of Supporting leadership behaviour will predict the subsequent change of Follower's relatedness need. And also, I already used LGM and found that both SUP and REL shows a positive quadraic growth pattern (decrease first and then increase over time). In this case, I'm not sure if my syntax is correct or not and I'm wondering if it is enough to just look at the estimate of the  xi_lag_yx ?

Here is my syntax below:

bi_lavaan_results<- fit_bi_lcsm (data = meandata_t1_t9,
            var_x = c("SUP_T1", "SUP_T2", "SUP_T3", "SUP_T4", "SUP_T5"),
            var_y = c("REL_T1", "REL_T2", "REL_T3", "REL_T4", "REL_T5"),
            model_x = list(alpha_piecewise = TRUE,
                           beta = TRUE,
                           phi = TRUE),
            model_y = list(alpha_piecewise = TRUE,
                           beta = TRUE,
                           phi = TRUE),
            coupling = list(delta_lag_xy = TRUE,
                           xi_lag_yx = TRUE))

# Now extract parameter estimates
# Only extract first 7 columns for this example by adding [ , 1:7]
param_bi_lcsm_01 <- extract_param(bi_lavaan_results,printp = TRUE)[ , 1:7]
# Print table of parameter estimates
print(param_bi_lcsm_01, n=22, digits = 3)

Many thanks in advance!
